data.title: Dubai Creek Residences
data.about:
Dubai Creek Residences in Dubai Creek Harbour has the perfect dream homes. With 1, 2, 3, bedroom apartments, Creek Residences offer you an unparalleled lifestyle. With 35 storeys, residents have the best views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic city skyline. Dubai Creek Residences is 100% ready and handovers are in progress.

Residents have the best amenities at their disposal. Live close to cafes and restaurants, as well as daycare’s, retail options, gyms and more. A marina lifestyle within the island district, Creek Residences is an obvious choice if you are looking of the waterfront lifestyle within Dubai.
